groups.label: DUAA effect on Data Protection Act 2018
groups.title_equals: Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 effect on Data Protection Act 2018
groups.note: Playbook already covers Arts 22A to 22D, special category limits, recognised legitimate interests, s164A complaints and SI 2026/425. Gap: Art 12A subject access timing and reasonable and proportionate search, now added to 5.6.5.
